name: Banded Romanian Deadlift
description: A band hip hinge: standing on the band, hold the ends near your knees, push your hips back until your torso is nearly level, then squeeze your glutes to stand.

source.title: Band-Resisted Romanian Deadlift (Girls Gone Strong)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand on the middle of the band, feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends short, near your knees, so there's tension.
cues: Flat back, soft knees, chest open.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Stand tall
keyframes.cue: Band taut, hands near your knees.

keyframes.name: Hinge
keyframes.cue: Push your hips back until your torso is nearly level.
